title: Scarlet Skips Hotfix 1.0.1
summary: The first hotfix added display options, filled out the park background and corrected issues affecting Rocket Shoes and extinguished ropes.
changes: Added FPS Limit and VSync options.
Fixed several bugs, specifically with Rocket Shoes and extinguished ropes not behaving correctly.
buildImpact: Rocket-based and fire-rope strategies should be retested on 1.0.1. The patch confirms those systems exist, but it does not publish numeric balance values.
guideImpact: Mechanics pages on this site are marked for version 1.0.1. Older player advice may describe pre-hotfix behavior, especially around Rocket Shoes and extinguished ropes.
